annotations.title: Save a record to DEOS Open

description: Free. Turns a draft record for one DEOS Open standard into a link that opens the DEOS Open app with the draft ready to save on the person's own device. CULT+MATH stores nothing: the draft travels inside the link. The four standards with a form (C1 Decision Record, C3 research brief, C5 gate, C13 Six-Lens Board) take draft as an object and come back with a shape check; every other standard takes text, its filled-in markdown template. Returns the link, the shape check and the standard's Done when list.

draft.description: For C1, C3, C5 and C13: the record as an object with the fields of that standard's JSON schema.

standard_id.description: The standard the record follows, e.g. "C1" (Decision Record).

text.description: For every other standard: the filled-in markdown template.

title.description: A short name for the record, e.g. "Launch on Google Play first".

name: save_to_deos_open
